# R&C - Retail & Commercial Design & Build

> Retail spaces. Commercial interiors. Built around your business.

R&C is a new Singapore design and build brand for retail and commercial spaces: shops and boutiques, offices and showrooms, cafes and service counters, salons and beauty studios. Services: integrated design and build, commercial carpentry, renovation, electrical works, tiling and flooring, painting and finishing, and audio, visual and lighting (AVL).

All images on the site are AI design concepts, not completed projects. No prices, reviews or project counts are published.

## Services
- [Design & Build for Retail and Commercial Spaces](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/retail-commercial-design-build/): Integrated planning, design and project coordination for retail and commercial spaces, with one point of coordination from brief to handover.
- [Commercial Carpentry for Shops and Business Premises](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/services/commercial-carpentry/): Custom counters, cabinets, display shelving, storage and reception joinery, planned around your products, equipment and floor layout.
- [Commercial Renovation and Fit-Out for Shops and Offices](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/services/commercial-renovation/): Fit-out and refurbishment execution for shops and offices, from partitions and ceilings to making good and lease-end reinstatement.
- [Commercial Electrical Works for Shops and Offices](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/services/commercial-electrical-works/): Power points, wiring and general lighting installation for business units, planned with counters, equipment and layout.
- [Commercial Tiling and Flooring for Business Spaces](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/services/commercial-tiling-flooring/): Tiles, vinyl and SPC, and coated floors for business premises, with preparation and material choices matched to traffic and cleaning.
- [Commercial Painting and Finishing for Shops and Offices](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/services/commercial-painting-finishing/): Wall and ceiling painting, feature walls, surface finishes and touch-ups, including finishing for reinstatement.

## AVL
- [Audio, Visual and Lighting for Commercial Spaces](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/avl/): Sound, screens and feature lighting planned as one experience, with cable paths, power and controls settled during fit-out.
- [Commercial Audio Systems for Shops, Cafes and Offices](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/avl/commercial-audio-systems/): Background music, speaker zones, volume control and meeting-room audio basics, planned with the fit-out.
- [Display and Visual Systems for Commercial Spaces](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/avl/display-visual-systems/): Displays, digital signage, menu boards and presentation screens, planned for mounting, viewing distance, brightness and cabling.
- [Architectural and Feature Lighting for Commercial Interiors](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/avl/architectural-feature-lighting/): Feature, accent and display lighting with colour, glare and dimming scene control, planned with the fit-out.

## Spaces
- [Retail Shop and Boutique Fit-Out in Singapore](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/spaces/retail-shops-boutiques/): Shelving, counters, flooring, lighting and finishes for boutiques, specialty shops and mall kiosks, planned around how your stock and customers move.
- [Office and Showroom Fit-Out in Singapore](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/spaces/offices-showrooms/): Reception counters, feature walls, meeting rooms and product display for offices and showrooms, with lighting and screens planned alongside the joinery.
- [Cafe Counters, Seating and Service Areas](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/spaces/cafes-service-counters/): Service counters, display cabinets, seating zones, finishes and menu screens for cafes and customer-facing counters.
- [Salon and Beauty Studio Fit-Out in Singapore](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/spaces/salons-beauty-studios/): Mirrored stations, concealed storage, reception counters and flattering lighting for hair salons, nail bars and beauty studios.

## Guides
- [How to Brief a Shop Fit-Out](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/guides/how-to-brief-a-shop-fit-out/): What to prepare before you speak to any contractor, and how to compare shop fit-out quotations on like-for-like scope.
- [Retail Display Shelving Materials Compared](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/guides/retail-display-shelving-materials/): Laminate, veneer, solid wood, metal, glass and acrylic compared for durability, load, cleaning, look and cost drivers.
- [Planning a Custom Shop Counter](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/guides/planning-a-custom-shop-counter/): How to plan a custom shop counter: functions, typical heights, accessibility, materials, and power and data points.
- [Small Shop Renovation Checklist](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/guides/small-shop-renovation-checklist/): A step-by-step checklist from lease review and landlord approvals through handover, defects and lease-end reinstatement.
- [Lighting a Retail Display](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/guides/lighting-a-retail-display/): Plan display lighting in layers, with notes on colour temperature, colour rendering, glare, aiming and dimming.
- [Background Music for Shops](https://pageonesingapore.com/preview/rc-design-build/guides/background-music-for-shops/): Plan shop background music: speaker placement, zoning, volume, sources, staff control and licensing questions to check.
